$comment: 语法大厅 G16（V0.9 P2a 骨架层）。比喻锚点：已排好的曲目单 vs 临时起意——be going to 是提前排好的曲目单，will 是安可时的临时加演。暗线侧写：will 与 going to 的语法化（常用词被磨虚磨短，gonna）。全部内容原创。
title: 一般将来时 will / be going to
metaphor: 已排好的曲目单 vs 临时起意
ketNote: KET Part 5 和听力里 will / be going to 都常出现；写作里约朋友、订计划（Part 6 小便条）几乎必用。

sections.essence: 将来的两种预告：排好的曲目单用 be going to，临时起意用 will。
sections.why: 中文说将来，动词照旧不动，前面摆个「要／会／打算」就行：「我明天要去」「我会帮你」。英语的将来也不给动词变形——它派了两位「报幕员」站在动词前面：will 和 be going to，后面的动词永远是原形。麻烦在于两位报幕员分工不同：be going to 报的是早就定好的安排和眼看要发生的事；will 报的是话说到一半当场做的决定、凭感觉的预测和许下的承诺。中文的「要」和「会」不做这种区分，所以中国孩子常常两个混着用。混用大多不算大错，但 KET 听力和 Part 5 恰恰爱考「哪个报幕员该上场」——先弄清分工，答题就是送分。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐队的音乐会有两种「预告」。第一种贴在门口：曲目单提前一周排好，白纸黑字——We are going to play three songs this Friday. 谁看了都知道，这是计划好的事，不是心血来潮。演出当晚还有第二种预告：三首演完，观众掌声不停，喊着安可。指挥回头冲团员一笑，当场拍板——All right, we'll play one more! 这句 will 是三秒钟前才做的决定，曲目单上可没有它。还有一幕：大提琴手抱着琴走到台中央，灯光打下来——不用看单子你也知道，He is going to play a solo，眼前的迹象已经写明白了；而你小声跟同桌说「我猜这首会特别好听」——I think it will be beautiful——那是凭感觉的预测。记住这个夜晚：单子上的、有迹象的，交给 be going to；当场决定的、凭感觉猜的、拍胸脯承诺的，交给 will。

cards.rule: 两位报幕员，动词都用原形
cards.detail: will + 动词原形；am/is/are going to + 动词原形——动词自己不变形，报时的活儿全交给前面。
cards.example: I will help. / She is going to sing.

cards.rule: be going to：排好的曲目单
cards.detail: 事先定好的计划、打算，说话前就决定了。be 要跟主语对上号（am/is/are）。
cards.example: We are going to visit Grandma next week.（早订好的）

cards.rule: be going to 还管「有迹象的预测」
cards.detail: 乌云压顶、琴手上台——眼前的迹象已经写明结果时，用 be going to。
cards.example: Look at those clouds — it's going to rain.

cards.detail: 话说到一半当场决定（I'll open the door!）、凭感觉预测（I think it will...）、许诺（I'll always help you）。
cards.example: The bag is heavy? I'll carry it for you.

cards.detail: will not 缩写成 won't（注意拼写不是 willn't）；提问把 will 或 be 举到主语前。
cards.example: I won't be late. / Will you come? / Is he going to play?

cards.detail: tomorrow / next week / soon / in ten minutes / this weekend——看到它们，给动词请一位报幕员。
cards.example: The concert will start in ten minutes.

basic.cn: 今晚我会给你打电话。（will + 原形）

basic.en: We are going to have a picnic on Saturday.
basic.cn: 我们周六要去野餐。（早计划好的）

basic.en: She will be ten years old next month.
They are going to watch a film after dinner.
basic.cn: 他们打算晚饭后看场电影。

mid.en: Look at the dark sky — it is going to snow.
mid.cn: 看这天色——要下雪了。（有迹象的预测）

mid.en: — The phone is ringing. — I'll get it!
mid.cn: ——电话响了。——我去接！（当场决定用 will）

mid.en: My cousin is going to learn the drums this term.
mid.cn: 我表弟这学期打算学架子鼓。（打算）

mid.en: Don't worry. I won't tell anyone.
mid.cn: 别担心，我不会告诉任何人。（承诺，won't）

mid.en: Will you join our band next year?
mid.cn: 你明年加入我们乐队吗？（will 举手提问）

trap.en: He will visit the museum tomorrow.
trap.cn: 他明天会去参观博物馆。
trap.note: will 后面永远原形——不是 will visits，三单的 s 别跟过来。

trap.en: I am going to practise the piano at five.
trap.note: be going to 里的 be 要跟主语配套——I am，不是 I going to。

trap.en: We won't be late for the show.
trap.cn: 我们看演出不会迟到的。
trap.note: will not 的缩写是 won't，不是 willn't。

trap.en: — We have no juice. — OK, I'll buy some on my way home.
trap.cn: ——没果汁了。——好，我回家路上买点。
trap.note: 听到消息「当场决定」→ will；这里用 am going to 就不对味了。

trap.en: She is going to be a music teacher one day.
trap.note: 「将来要当」是长期打算——be going to be，两个 be 各干各的活。

trap.en: The train leaves at six, so we will meet at half past five.
trap.cn: 火车六点开，所以我们五点半碰头。
trap.note: 时刻表本身用一般现在（leaves）；「我们碰头」的约定才请报幕员。

redBlack.bad: I go to Beijing next week.（想说下周要去）
redBlack.good: I am going to Beijing next week.
redBlack.why: 没有任何将来标记，听的人以为你说「我常去北京」——计划这件事传达不出去。

redBlack.bad: Don't worry, I help you.（想说我会帮你）
redBlack.good: Don't worry, I will help you.
redBlack.why: 少了 will，承诺变成了干巴巴的「我帮你」陈述——安慰的力度全没了。

redBlack.bad: He will goes to the concert with us.
redBlack.good: He will go to the concert with us.
redBlack.why: will 后面永远接原形——三单的 s 不许跟上台。

redBlack.bad: I going to clean my room this afternoon.
redBlack.good: I am going to clean my room this afternoon.
redBlack.why: going to 前面丢了 be——am/is/are 是这套装备的一半。

redBlack.bad: She is going to sings at the party.
redBlack.good: She is going to sing at the party.
redBlack.why: going to 后面也是原形——sings 的 s 多余。

redBlack.bad: They is going to plant trees tomorrow.
redBlack.good: They are going to plant trees tomorrow.
redBlack.why: they 配 are——be 要跟主语对上号。

redBlack.bad: I willn't eat too much ice cream.
redBlack.good: I won't eat too much ice cream.
redBlack.why: will not 的缩写是 won't——willn't 是不存在的拼法。

redBlack.bad: Will you going to the park with me?
redBlack.good: Are you going to the park with me? / Will you go to the park with me?
redBlack.why: will 和 be going to 是两位报幕员，不能挤在同一句里报幕。

redBlack.bad: Look at those clouds! It will rain right now!
redBlack.good: Look at those clouds! It's going to rain!
redBlack.why: 乌云是眼前的迹象——有迹象的预测该 be going to 上场。

redBlack.bad: We will to watch the fireworks tonight.
redBlack.good: We will watch the fireworks tonight.
redBlack.why: will 后面直接接原形，不要 to——它不是 want to 那一家的。

redBlack.bad: I am going to go to the shop.（有人说啰嗦）
redBlack.good: I am going to the shop. / I am going to go there. 都行。
redBlack.why: going to go 语法没错只是拗口，口语常省成 going to + 地点——意思不挡，考试不设这个坑。

redBlack.bad: Tomorrow I gonna play basketball.（作文里）
redBlack.good: Tomorrow I am going to play basketball.
redBlack.why: gonna 是口语缩读，聊天没问题；作文里写全 be going to 更稳，而且 gonna 前面也不能丢 be。

contrast.cn: 我明天要去外婆家。（「要」+动词，动词不变）
contrast.en: I am going to visit Grandma tomorrow.
contrast.diff: 中文一个「要」全包；英语从「计划」角度选 be going to，还得让 be 跟主语配套。
中文「会」也表承诺；英语的承诺、当场决定归 will 管，不归 be going to。

contrast.cn: 要下雨了。（一个「要」看不出凭什么）
contrast.en: It's going to rain.（指着乌云说）/ I think it will rain.（凭感觉猜）
contrast.diff: 中文不区分「有迹象」和「凭感觉」；英语靠选哪位报幕员把依据也说了出去。

contrast.cn: 他明天会来吗？（加「吗」就是问句）
contrast.en: Will he come tomorrow?（will 举到最前面）
contrast.diff: 中文问将来靠语气词；英语把 will 举到主语前面提问。

contrast.cn: 火车六点开。（将来的事照说）
contrast.en: The train leaves at six.（时刻表用一般现在）
contrast.diff: 英语给时刻表开了特例：板上钉钉的时间表连报幕员都不用请。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 先问定没定：早定了 going to，现定的 will；有迹象 going to，凭感觉 will。
steps: 看到 tomorrow / next... / soon → 这句要请将来报幕员。
问：这事是说话前就定好的计划吗？是 → be going to（be 跟主语配套）。
问：是眼前迹象写明要发生？（乌云、琴手上台）是 → be going to。
问：是话到嘴边当场决定、凭感觉预测、或者承诺？是 → will。
无论谁上场，后面的动词一律原形——三单 s 和 to 都不许跟上台。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语说将来的事有两个说法：早就计划好的用 be going to，比如周六的野餐；话说到一半临时决定的用 will，比如我现在说『我去开门』。咱们玩『曲目单和安可』：你先用英语说三件这周计划好的事，都用 going to 开头；然后我们演一场戏——我说『垃圾满了』『下雨了』『我口渴了』，你当场决定做点什么，用 I'll 开头回答我。我不懂英语没关系，我只听开头是 going to 还是 I'll。」听到她说 I going to（丢了 am）或 will goes（动词带了 s），就提醒一句「报幕员后面站原形」。
questions: 周六野餐是早定好的计划，该用 will 还是 be going to？
「电话响了，我去接！」这种当场决定用哪个词开头？
will 和 going to 后面的动词要不要加 s？为什么？

sections.echo: will 在古英语里是个实打实的动词 willan，意思是「想要」——「我想要去」说得多了，「想要」的味道被磨掉，只剩下「将要」这个空壳。be going to 更有意思：它本来真的是「正走去做某事」——I am going to the market to buy eggs，走着走着，「走」的脚步声也被磨没了，只剩「打算」；口语里连 going to 都嫌长，磨成了 gonna。语言学家管这叫「语法化」：实词被高频使用磨成语法零件。你又见到那条暗线的侧影了——越常用的词，越是被磨得面目全非。

memoryCard.alt: G16 记忆卡：be going to=排好的曲目单（计划+有迹象预测），will=临时起意（当场决定+凭感觉预测+承诺）；两者后面动词都用原形；否定 won't；警示 will goes、I going to、will to go、Will you going 四类错误。

questions.q: 早就计划好的事，用哪位报幕员？
questions.explain: 排好的曲目单——be going to。

questions.q: 话说到一半当场做的决定，用哪个？
questions.explain: 临时起意——will。

questions.q: will 后面的动词用什么形式？
questions.explain: 报幕员后面永远站原形。

questions.q: be going to 后面的动词用什么形式？
questions.explain: going to 后面也是原形。

questions.q: will not 的缩写是？
questions.explain: 特殊拼法 won't，要单独记。

questions.q: I ___ going to water the flowers.
questions.explain: I 配 am——be 跟主语配套。

questions.q: She ___ going to learn the flute.
questions.explain: she 配 is。

questions.q: They ___ going to visit the zoo.
questions.explain: they 配 are。

questions.q: tomorrow 是哪个时间的信号词？
questions.explain: 明天——请将来报幕员。

questions.q: 下面哪个是将来的信号词？
questions.explain: next week＝下周，将来。

questions.q: 看见乌云说「要下雨了」，属于哪种预告？
options: 有迹象的预测 → be going to
questions.explain: 迹象摆在眼前——It's going to rain。

questions.q: 「我永远支持你」这种承诺用哪个？
questions.explain: 承诺归 will 管。

questions.q: 下面哪句是「临时起意」？
options: The phone is ringing — I'll get it!
We are going to fly to Sanya next month.
questions.explain: 听到铃声当场决定——will。

questions.q: 下面哪句是「排好的曲目单」？
options: We are going to have a class party on Friday.
OK, I'll open the window now.
She sang a song just now.
questions.explain: 周五的班级聚会早定好了——be going to。

questions.q: will 提问时站在哪里？
questions.explain: Will you come?——举到主语前。

questions.q: He will ___ the guitar at the show.
questions.explain: will 后面站原形 play。

stages.name: 选一选 · 排单还是加演

questions.q: — The box is too heavy for Grandma. — I ___ carry it for her!
questions.explain: 看到情况当场决定帮忙——will。

questions.q: We ___ camp by the lake next weekend. Everything is packed!
questions.explain: 行李都收好了——早定的计划用 are going to。

questions.q: Look at the dark clouds! It ___ rain soon.
questions.explain: 乌云是迹象——is going to。

questions.q: I think our team ___ win the game tomorrow.
questions.explain: I think + 凭感觉预测——will。

questions.q: — We need some bread. — OK, I ___ some at the corner shop.
questions.explain: 听到消息当场决定——I'll buy。

questions.q: My aunt ___ a baby next month.
questions.explain: 下个月的事早已注定——is going to have。

questions.q: Don't tell anyone — I ___ keep your secret.
questions.explain: 承诺——will keep。

questions.q: ___ you going to join the art club this term?
questions.explain: be going to 提问由 be 举手——Are you going to...?

questions.q: ___ your brother come to the show tonight?
questions.explain: will 提问——Will + 主语 + 原形。

questions.q: Hurry! The bus ___ leave — the door is closing!
questions.explain: 车门正关是眼前迹象——is going to leave。

questions.q: I promise I ___ be late again.
questions.explain: 承诺的否定——won't。

questions.q: She ___ ten next Sunday, so we're planning a party.
questions.explain: will + be 原形——will be ten。

questions.q: What ___ you going to do this weekend?
questions.explain: going to 的特殊疑问句仍由 are 举手。

questions.q: It's cold in here. I ___ close the window.
questions.explain: 感到冷当场决定——I'll close。

questions.q: We ___ move to a new flat in September. Dad signed the papers.
questions.explain: 合同都签了——铁定的计划用 are going to。

questions.q: Maybe robots ___ cook dinner for us one day.
questions.explain: 对遥远将来的猜想——will。

questions.q: 哪句的报幕员后面站对了？
options: He will visit his uncle tomorrow.
He will visits his uncle tomorrow.
He will visited his uncle tomorrow.
questions.explain: will 后面站原形——visit。

questions.q: 哪句的 be 没丢？
options: I am going to wash the dishes.
I going to wash the dishes.
I be going to wash the dishes.
questions.explain: be going to 的 be 要现身且配套——I am。

questions.q: 哪句的 going to 后面干净利落？
options: She is going to dance at the party.
She is going to dances at the party.
She is going to danced at the party.
questions.explain: going to + 原形 dance。

questions.q: 哪句的否定写对了？
options: We will forget not your birthday.
questions.explain: will not → won't。

questions.q: 哪句没把两位报幕员挤上同一个台？
options: Are you going to buy that hat?
Will you going to buy that hat?
Do you going to buy that hat?
questions.explain: will 和 be going to 只能请一位。

questions.q: 哪句的 to 没多长出来？
options: They will plant trees on the hill.
They will to plant trees on the hill.
They will planting trees on the hill.
questions.explain: will 直接接原形，不带 to。

questions.q: 哪句的 be 跟主语配对了？
options: My parents are going to cook noodles tonight.
My parents is going to cook noodles tonight.
My parents am going to cook noodles tonight.
questions.explain: parents 复数 → are。

questions.q: 哪句给「乌云压顶」选对了报幕员？
options: Look at the sky — it's going to storm!
Look at the sky — it will storm right now!
Look at the sky — it storms tomorrow!
questions.explain: 眼前迹象——be going to。

questions.q: 哪句给「当场决定」选对了报幕员？
options: — Someone's knocking. — I'll open the door.
— Someone's knocking. — I'm going to open the door since last week.
— Someone's knocking. — I opened the door tomorrow.
questions.explain: 敲门声响起才决定——I'll。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（下周二我们要考数学——早通知过）
options: We are going to have a maths test next Tuesday.
We will suddenly have a maths test next Tuesday.
We are going to had a maths test next Tuesday.
questions.explain: 早就通知的安排——are going to have。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我保证不再乱扔袜子）
options: I promise I won't throw my socks around again.
I promise I don't will throw my socks around.
I promise I willn't throw my socks around.
questions.explain: 承诺的否定 won't，位置在主语后。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（你觉得明天会晴吗）
options: Do you think it will be sunny tomorrow?
Do you think it will is sunny tomorrow?
Do you think it going to sunny tomorrow?
questions.explain: will + be 原形——will be sunny。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（她打算当兽医）
options: She is going to be a vet.
She is going to is a vet.
She will be going to a vet.
questions.explain: going to + be 原形——两个 be 各干各的活。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我们十分钟后出发）
options: We will leave in ten minutes.
We will leave ten minutes ago.
questions.explain: in ten minutes＝十分钟后，将来——will leave。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（他不打算卖那把旧吉他）
options: He isn't going to sell his old guitar.
He doesn't going to sell his old guitar.
He isn't go to sell his old guitar.
questions.explain: be going to 的否定在 be 上加 not——isn't going to。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（灯要灭了——你看它在闪）
options: The light is going to go out — it's flashing!
The light will go out on purpose — it's flashing!
The light went out tomorrow — it's flashing!
questions.explain: 灯在闪是迹象——is going to go out。

questions.q: — Why are you carrying a bucket? — I ___ the car with Dad.（早约好的）
questions.explain: 拎着桶＝计划早定好——am going to wash。

questions.q: — Oh no, I left my pen at home! — Don't worry, I ___ you mine.
questions.explain: 听到消息当场决定——I'll lend。

questions.q: The sky is black and the wind is strong. There ___ a storm.
questions.explain: 天色是迹象——is going to be a storm。

questions.q: I believe you ___ a great drummer some day.
questions.explain: I believe + 对将来的信心——will be。

questions.q: — We ___ a school concert next Friday. Would you like to come? — Sure!
questions.explain: 下周五的音乐会是排好的安排——are going to have。

questions.q: — The teacher is coming! — Quick, I ___ the door for her.
questions.explain: 当场起身——I'll hold the door。

questions.q: — What are your plans for the holiday? — We ___ our grandparents in Xi'an.
questions.explain: 问 plans 答计划——are going to visit。

questions.q: Careful! The glass is rolling to the edge — it ___!
questions.explain: 杯子已滚到桌边，迹象十足——is going to fall。

questions.q: — Will you come to my party? — Yes, I ___. I promise.
questions.explain: Will you...? 的简答用 will——Yes, I will。

questions.q: — Is she going to sing tonight? — No, she ___. She has a sore throat.
questions.explain: Are/Is...going to 的简答用 be——No, she isn't。

questions.q: My plan is ready: first I ___ my homework, then I ___ a model plane.
options: am going to finish / am going to build
questions.explain: 既然说了 plan is ready——两步都是排好的单子。

questions.q: — The dog looks thirsty. — You're right. I ___ it some water now.
questions.explain: 看到情况当场决定——I'll give。

questions.q: The film starts at 7:30, so we ___ at the gate at 7:15, OK?
questions.explain: 时刻表用 starts；「我们碰头」的约定请 will——will meet。

questions.q: Everyone says the new bridge ___ next spring — the workers are already halfway.
questions.explain: 工程过半是明摆的迹象——is going to open。

questions.q: — I can't reach the top shelf. — Wait, I ___ the ladder for you.
questions.explain: 当场决定去搬梯子——I'll get。

questions.q: 大考：Next Sunday we ___ a picnic. I think it ___ fun, and I promise I ___ my camera.
options: are going to have / will be / won't forget
will have suddenly / is going to is / willn't forget
questions.explain: 计划 are going to have；凭感觉预测 will be；承诺 won't forget——三种预告一次配齐。

detective.sentence: He will plays the drum at the school show.
detective.fixed: He will play the drum at the school show.
detective.clue: will 后面永远站原形——三单的 s 不许跟上台。

detective.sentence: I going to visit the science museum tomorrow.
detective.fixed: I am going to visit the science museum tomorrow.
detective.clue: going to 前面丢了 be——I am going to。

detective.sentence: She is going to buys new shoes this weekend.
detective.fixed: She is going to buy new shoes this weekend.
detective.clue: going to 后面也是原形——buys 的 s 多余。

detective.sentence: We willn't be late for the morning bus.
detective.fixed: We won't be late for the morning bus.
detective.clue: will not 的缩写是 won't——willn't 是不存在的拼法。

detective.sentence: Will you going to watch the dragon boat race?
detective.fixed: Are you going to watch the dragon boat race? / Will you watch the dragon boat race?
detective.clue: will 和 be going to 两位报幕员挤上了同一个台——只能留一位。

detective.sentence: Look, the baby's lips are moving — she will cry right now!
detective.fixed: Look, the baby's lips are moving — she is going to cry!
detective.clue: 嘴瘪了是眼前的迹象——有迹象的预测请 be going to。

detective.sentence: They will to sing a new song at the party.
detective.fixed: They will sing a new song at the party.
detective.clue: will 直接接原形，不带 to——它不是 want to 那一家的。
